Revision 5 has the correct scopes, original metadata guards, explicit each and preserved external work. Preserve them and all six accepted requirements unchanged. Make only these concrete implementation corrections:

1. The three extract tasks declare each over records but their recordCandidates result is array<object>. That contract requires exactly one object for every source record, so their stated zero-or-more candidates/empty irrelevant result is impossible. Change each one's sole result field to array<array<object>>: the outer array still has exactly one entry per source record, and that entry is an array of source-grounded candidates, empty only after checking irrelevance. Keep each:{input:records,output:recordCandidates}, inputs, guards, objectives and exports. The existing page loop then collects these nested arrays; global interpretation may read them without flattening or filtering in extraction's outer semantics. No per-page truncation, rank, invented status or default. A relevant record outside generation examples must still be processed.

2. Narrow each candidate object for its actual consumer. Initial search consent/product decision keeps the exact observed control selector and grouping plus necessary text/link/control fields. Post-consent selection has no click consumer: keep kind/group/text/href, removing selector/tag/role unless materially required for the declared product-link decision. Product-field selection has the known candidateUrl already: retain kind/tag/group/text and omit selector/href/role. Update those extraction objectives to the exact declared views. Full originals remain in the read operation results as evidence, not model inputs. This is field selection plus explicit extraction of relevant observed candidates, not arbitrary deletion of necessary context.

3. assemble_products currently interprets an existing typed collected array. Replace only that ordinary copy with a value task exporting products from visit_products.product, preserving its task identity, scope, order, requires guard and consumers. Keep real global decisions in interpret; keep final TSV formatting explicit. Do not remove product visits, writes, file-path provenance or cleanup; do not alter accepted public inputs/results, other guards, maxItems, maxRecords or permissions.

Return the full revised plan; this review explicitly authorizes these result-type/view corrections and the one deterministic copy replacement only. No scripts, new abstractions, raw-page leakage or new inference phases.
